$comment: SSDD per-project config — the injection contract. Seeded as <repo>/.ssdd/config.json by `bin/ssdd.mjs install` (project-owned: updates never overwrite it); fill in the project's routing/rules. All 'paths' / 'include' / 'exclude' values are JS regex sources tested against repo-relative POSIX paths.

routing.$comment: Where cost shows up: rendering, the server's queries, dependency weight. Not every source file.
What the docs describe (scripts, endpoints, settings), not all source; the final whole-plan review catches the rest.
Any route may carry a $comment recording WHY a path is in this lens (e.g. the incident that showed it was missing). The gate ignores it.

paths.$comment: Where plans, specs and ledgers live, repo-relative. Read by the work-state view, the close check, --next-plan and the migration (.ssdd/hooks/work-state.mjs); the process docs and skills name these settings. Defaults shown.

reviewGate.$comment: maxRoutedFiles: WARN (not block) when a staged diff touches more routed files than this — the per-task commit rule is being skipped. Docs/ledgers don't count. Default 10. commentReviewer: the reviewer that still re-reviews a comment-only change to a file it is routed to (every other reviewer's clean stamp carries over it). Default "docs-sync-reviewer". maxRounds: WARN (not block) when a reviewer has re-reviewed a file this many times with a finding still open — stop and ask the user whether to rethink or triage. Default 3. A route's "exclude" drops files from that route, e.g. test files, which is why every route above carries one.

productionGuard.$comment: prod-guard (.ssdd/hooks/prod-guard.mjs) asks before anything that would change production outside writePath, which its reasons quote. extraRules: {match (a regex source, tested against each shell command with its quoted words blanked, or against an MCP call's tool name), decision: "ask" | "deny", reason}. e.g. {"match": "\\bvercel\\s+deploy\\b.*--prod\\b", "decision": "ask", "reason": "deploys to production"}. A pack's options sit under its name: see .ssdd/packs/<name>/README.md.

extraRules.$comment: Matches --force (not --force-with-lease / --force-if-includes), bundled short -f, and +refspec — within the push command only (stops at ; & | newline).
extraRules.message: Blocked: force push (--force, -f, or +refspec). Use --force-with-lease, and only after the user's explicit go-ahead.

lint.name: no-hardcoded-hex-colors
lint.$comment: A 3, 4, 6 or 8-digit hex colour, not in a comment and not four bare digits (#1234 is an issue, not a colour). A line holding ssdd-lint-ignore is skipped by every rule.
lint.message: Hardcoded color — import from the design tokens instead.
